# Reassess chrome-alum parent rationale on double-salt as well as hydrate evidence

Reviewed W02 head `0597d00417be4d7cdfb5a31970043eec9bbc88fe`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Authoritative peer review is `assembly-v2/review.yaml` (SHA256 `31cac38cae0cfb3dcfae4453a01402dc98d249f70ad9a7698a89b25eed5eae11`) in the sealed W04 independent W02 packet, whose 2,399-member SHA256SUMS is `99306617655b1e3df84368079e49f4341a0fd05667bdf9fedf18dda24f4f7ca7`. The coordinator verified all manifest members, rebound all188 case decisions and106 selected payloads, and independently repeated all106 native guarded writes and baseline/overlay partonomy. Structural validation passes; the scientific verdict remains needs_curation. These are unapplied proposal corrections, not changes already made to main or whole-owner/export approval.

`W02-F-CHROME-ALUM-RELATION` (`w02-external-b-009`, cases2/18) identifies a retained rationale gap. The exact chrome-alum owner denotes potassium chromium sulfate dodecahydrate, CAS7788-99-0. The [supplier](https://www.sigmaaldrich.com/US/en/product/saj/054560) states CrK(SO4)2·12H2O; captured response SHA256 `77b726fcac0fc0b767c38e78366aef115d4ab3bda6b0e7f052289b8c819d2762`. Its selected CHEBI53471 target is chromium(III) sulfate, formula2Cr·3O4S ([ChEBI](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/api/ontologies/chebi/terms?obo_id=CHEBI:53471), capture `31570b47373542315c166514c0e90d6a5dd201b03d2cadc524327392f07b6ef6`). Potassium and salt stoichiometry differ, not only hydration.

The current CLOSE_MATCH justification inherited from342 describes hydrate versus anhydrous form and does not establish this double-salt relation. Preserve own CAS and authentic history; assess the closest supported ontology relation under current MAPPING_SEMANTICS. Do not automatically change CLOSE_MATCH to NARROW_MATCH, assert that chromium sulfate is an is_a parent, or merge distinct salts. A justified non-exact relationship may remain; the defect is the incomplete active rationale, not proof that every non-exact relation must disappear.

Full closed342 and245 comments were inspected. They record historical hydrate/predicate decisions and later SKOS direction, not an exact potassium-double-salt justification. Live all-state chrome-alum title/body/comment searches found no dedicated tracker. Record the bounded reassessment without silently rewriting those prior decisions.

title: Correct the tellurium dioxide proposal parent grade before native publication
body:
Worker05 reported **W05-FINAL-CHEM-NEW-01** before fixing it; an independent read-only reproduction confirms a record-grade defect in isolated proposal `CHEM-C1193-tellurium-dioxide`. Its exact payload SHA256 is `d25ae183c58c8616ecff3fd43dfb4615cb30d4df94e8a17399f09c2de3b20e98`, published under head `43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d` at `reports/all_unmatched_20261107/worker-05/correction-1193-v1/chemicals/proposed/Tellurium_Dioxide.yaml`, intended new owner `data/ingredients/mapped/Tellurium_Dioxide.yaml`. The original proposal and referral remain immutable; no maintained record or mapping was changed.

The record preserves the exact compound identity `cas:7446-07-3` and uses `CHEBI:33305 tellurium molecular entity` as a broader class. It currently grades that relationship `BROAD_MATCH`. Under MAPPING_SEMANTICS§1/§3, the dioxide is the narrower entity, so the intended asymmetric parent relation requires `NARROW_MATCH`. This is not a request to change the producer's global BROAD_MATCH behavior.

| Actual native projection | Parent relation | Exact registry identities |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Current BROAD_MATCH | closeMatch CHEBI:33305 | cas:7446-07-3 |
| Only grade changed in memory to NARROW_MATCH | broadMatch CHEBI:33305 | cas:7446-07-3 and kgmicrobe.compound:tellurium_dioxide |

The unchanged pinned Claw76c1ebee builder SHA256 `38d59f42953305f6fc51e4fc24dfc59ee1919bfb961595b67a8afe9f8a46a1bc` reproduces both sets exactly. The corrected output additionally places the CAS display token on registry rows, rather than the asymmetric parent row. Review the complete three-row native output; do not substitute one hand-edited predicate cell.

Primary scope remains precise. [CCAP UCM](https://www.ccap.ac.uk/wp-content/uploads/MR_UCM.pdf), PDF SHA256 `29ffa5707345821ccd91e72e7e633652e5364ed04283b42a63b683f09c0006a9`, names TeO2 both in primary trace stock4 (0.034g per100mL with NaOH) and the separate diluted trace stock (0.000034g/L). Its final growth-medium dilution is a further level. The two frozen occurrences belong to those nested source contexts; they are not two independently known final-medium doses. [NITE](https://www.chem-info.nite.go.jp/chem/english/ghs/m-nite-7446-07-3e.html) confirms tellurium dioxide/CAS7446-07-3, and [PubChem62638](https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/compound/62638) corroborates the dioxide. Preserve the exact compound, raw TeO as rejected provenance, and all source/export/role holds. Do not identify it with elemental tellurium, tellurite, or globally normalize TeO (which can denote monoxide elsewhere).

Append truthful grade-correction history to a new isolated successor after filing; keep the original evidence and quantities intact. §0 does not make this class grounding an exact CAS-to-ontology resolution merely because the distinct compound has a CAS number. Reassess exact-term priority if new evidence establishes an exact term; the original finite searches are not proof of universal ontology absence. Independently review corrected whole bytes and all native rows. The separate new human-only MappingEvidence entry is already covered by #1226 and must be handled honestly in the successor, without a global enum substitution or approval widening.

Deduplication: fresh all-state Tellurium searches including title/body/comments returned no issue. #1238 covers a separate Tris-hydrochloride proposal; #696 and #884 cover the broader grade/schema questions. Their full current bodies/comments were read. No schema, producer, gate, threshold, test or owner-selection change is requested. The original candidate can mechanically project its stored grade; this finding does not claim a current canonical QC failure.

Independent exact evidence: `C/preflight/tellurium-grade-triage-v1/native-reproduction.json`; original reporter receipt SHA256 `76ccc0c0664af7c6977197ebab41ec19c1637ba56c615209a93c2413e1d7bfdf`. The formulated product is not identical to its generic FAC component. No medium occurrence is inferred to use this medicine.

title: Reconcile source-bound preparation families before installing duplicate or unsupported owners
body:
The completed independent preparation-comparison packets identify duplicate proposed preparations, source-continuity conflicts and unsupported claims of disjointness. This issue tracks only the bounded family decisions below. These are isolated proposals; no record merge, new namespace, scientific approval or export release is authorized by the review.

All three sealed packets were independently hash-checked: Worker01 878 files, Worker05 390, Worker10 526, with no hash mismatch or unlisted file in the ignored-inclusive inventories. Their assignments partition the 67 mechanical family leads (26/22/19); this means comparison coverage, not 67 resolved or approved identities. The exact 28 retained finding/obligation IDs are reduced to 26 rows in `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/family-findings-triage-v1/findings-matrix-v2.json`. Original authors, skeptical reviews, proposal bytes, primary capture times/hashes, source cases and occurrences remain immutable.

A source accession, filename, receiving dose, missing carrier, unknown pH or unspecified hydrate does not prove a distinct supplied preparation. Nor does it prove equality. Source-qualified partial proposals remain useful; overlapping candidates need a defined scope or the missing evidence before simultaneous installation. No unknown is filled by guessing. Source-batch water and final-volume instructions remain separate, and immediate-list completeness is independent of molecular grounding.

| Findings / frozen entries | Sourced conclusion and bounded next action |
|---|---|
| W01-FPC-PA-001 + MIN-F03; 573/810, maintained ATCC_Wolfes_Vitamin_Mix | JCM197, NBRC837 and NBRC903 give the same ten nominal vitamins and amounts plus1L water. Prepare one combined nominal candidate preserving all source-specific processing. The maintained ATCC owner has authentic branded MD-VS history and a D-(+) calcium-pantothenate specification; JCM/NBRC only say calcium pantothenate. Preserve that distinction in what the evidence asserts: unspecified stereo proves neither sameness nor difference. Do not automatically reuse ATCC or install two source-number owners. Establish the applicability bridge or explicitly decide nominal-recipe versus supplied-product scope before co-installation. |
| MIN-F01; 624/657 | DSM590/1144 Hutner tables and preparation match at nominal scope. Preserve CaCl2·2H2O3.335g versus3.34g rounding and both malformed molybdate strings as literal unresolved assertions; do not turn a typographical discrepancy into a different chemical. Prepare one source-union nominal recipe candidate. Both underlying Metals44 instructions are retained; the current automatically extracted portal is not a historical erratum. |
| MIN-F02, W05-CR-F02; 381–384/624/657/705 | Wolfe JCM470/DSM792, modified Wolfe ATCC1190/1191 versus JCM221, and Hutner JCM900/979 comparisons have explicit unresolved hydrate/reagent or preparation details. Correct claims that missing qualifiers prove incompatibility. Do not infer JCM470's variable Mn hydrate as monohydrate, or transfer ATCC final-volume/form-specific instructions to JCM221. Preserve the positively different JCM149 MgSO4 quantity14.45g versus29.7g. |
| W01-FPC-PA-003; 747 plus existing JCM403 B12 owner | NBRC1321 explicitly gives cyanocobalamin5mg with100ml water; JCM403 specifies generic B12 at matching nominal quantities. Preserve both levels of specificity. Missing JCM vitamer/preparation evidence is an unresolved relation, not a proved difference or an exact identity bridge. Coordinate the existing JCM403 promotion/pointer correction under1201/1227; do not create a competing owner by accession alone. |
| W01-PREP-B-001; 619 | NBRC1507 names0.1M Tris/HCl pH7.5 stock but does not list free hydrochloric acid as a separate component. Remove that unsupported free-acid has-part claim. Preserve the literal named buffer, strength and pH with unknown complete composition; do not substitute dry Tris-HCl salt or invent solvent/neutralization. |
| W01-PREP-B-002 + CHEM-COMP-003; 669 | JCM1479 positively specifies a5% L-cysteine-HCl-monohydrate stock atpH7. Unreported pH of other5% stocks does not establish a different substance. Correct the comparison wording, retain stock/solid separation and the unknown percentage basis/carrier/titrant. |
| CHEM-COMP-002; 6/13 | NBRC1020 prints Na2WO4; JCM317 explicitly prints dihydrate, both at4mg with4mg selenite and1L water. Remove the claim that omission proves anhydrous NBRC1020 or disjointness. Preserve both literal tables and ask only for the missing supplied form if full chemical equivalence is needed. |
| CHEM-COMP-004; 943/944/946/106 | Literal35%,32%,25% HCl and qualitative concentrated labels have unknown comparable bases; M2305/M2746 even call their25% input concentrated. Correct categorical disjointness without converting percentages or inventing a carrier. Retain source qualification; an explicit common partial-material scope or comparable formulation evidence is needed before consolidation. |
| BIO-COMP-005; 328/333 with283/287/288/290 | Historical MJ and JCM1216 0.1x artificial-seawater formulations remain partly unspecified. Missing recipe/version is not evidence of a different formulation. Preserve the source-qualified preparations, positive known differences and exact missing historical MJ/1x-base specification; no guessed formula or wholesale seawater merge. |
| BIO-COMP-001; 201/476 | CM0643 prepared broth and dry powder are different supplied forms. The source handles for entry201 use1000ml/10ml broth; entry476 weighs33g powder. Correct entry201's dry-powder representation and account for its authentic existing broth provenance. Retain powder separate from prepared broth, water and receiving supplements; the same catalogue does not erase the supplied-form boundary. MICRO:0002186 describes liquid, so any use requires whole-broth§3 scope review and must not identify powder. |
| BIO-F02; 971 + Swine_Serum | The new DSM1076b heat-inactivated swine-serum proposal uses MediaDive960, already the creation source of Swine_Serum/UNMAPPED_0536. Reconcile or promote through that authentic preimage/history. Do not add a second same-source owner or label the separate generic Porcine_Serum/MD967 untreated. Heat schedule remains unknown. |
| BIO-F03; 970 + Bovine_Calf_Serum | JCM1303 heat-inactivated calf serum uses MediaDive2061, already the import source of Bovine_Calf_Serum. Audit its broader/Gibco occurrences and partition their applicability before narrowing or adding an owner. Missing historical heat metadata is not an untreated claim. No wholesale repurposing or maintained-owner merge. |
| BIO-F04; 893/908/914/916/922 | Withdraw unsupported serum exclusions: bovine does not exclude fetal; gamma irradiation does not exclude heat treatment; unspecified heat schedule need not differ from a specified one. Retain positive age/species/catalogue/process facts and actual30/45/60minute or active/inactivated differences. No forced product equivalence. |
| BIO-F05; 904/906 | JCM946 supports56C30min heating and filtration before addition, but not their relative order. Clarify only that ordering claim. DSM1021 explicitly requires sterile fetal/newborn alternatives; preserve sterility for the selected newborn scope without inventing heat or filter treatment. |
| BIO-F06; 300/921 | Oxoid CM0331 and TOGO M2224 disclose the same nominal dry base: special peptone23g, starch1g, NaCl5g, agar10g, pH7.3±0.2. Prepare one combined formulation candidate while retaining which source actually states the catalogue. Before installation, account for existing Columbia_Blood_Agar_Base's mixed Oxoid/Difco provenance; do not repurpose the entire owner. Preserve the distinct Difco/BBL/EH formulations. Blood and reconstitution water are not dry-base parts. |
| BIO-F07; 980 | Replace a search-wrapper-as-primary assertion with the recovered2009 BD manufacturer manual capture, p158. Keep original wrapper, older manual edition and failed URLs as historical evidence. This verifies the nominal Difco formulation, not a historical lot or arbitrary vendor equivalence. |
| BIO-F08; 919 | Current ATCC0988 is explicitly reformulated asMD2611 and specifies ATCC30-2020 plus55C treatment; frozen TOGO M2578 preserves older fetal/newborn alternatives and unknown schedule. Keep both versions and their exact applicability. Same URL is not same document; this is a version obligation, not a finding that the frozen transcription is false. |
| CHEM-COMP-006; 35/36 | Reassess new claim-specific resolver dispositions. The fully specified0.01M FeSO4·7H2O in0.02N HCl name is not shown to be a non-name merely because a global alias was undesirable. Bicarbonate footnote pointers have different ambiguity. Preserve all existing rejected entries; do not blanket-reactivate or blanket-reject authentic labels. Under§3, any new rejection needs claim-specific evidence; owned-name suppression applies only when its ownership condition holds. Historical1173 lineage is not a new scientific decision. |

Additional reconciliation groups with positive evidence can proceed to isolated candidate preparation, with exact-byte independent review before application:

- DAIGO395-01681 entries188/474: one named dry product, eight manufacturer components. Preserve the manufacturer/JCM peptone wording and exact hydrate, the3.15g listed sum versus3.2g preparation instruction, and both histories. Do not invent another constituent, agar, water, generic DSM1537 applicability or wholesale KG1402 routing. The local identifier is already shared; choose one readable destination by the product scope, not author order.
- Mixed phosphate entries873/940: one nominal preparation from equal volumes of1M KH2PO4 and1M Na2HPO4. Preserve50+50ml versus10+10ml batches and PBBM-onlypH7.2. The immediate input list can be complete without claiming its input stocks' exact hydrate, solvent or neutralization chemistry.
- HEPES-KOH1M entries449/450 (W05-CR-F01): both sources positively name the same nominal strength/neutralizer; receiving-mediumpH7.14/9.0 is not stockpH. Recommend an explicit common bounded nominal scope if that is the intended owner model; otherwise retain candidate holds for actual stockpH/carrier/neutralization evidence. Do not install two proved-distinct preparations based solely on source numbers.
- 95% ethanol entries460–463 (W05-CR-F03): preserve proven within-protocol reuse and every occurrence. A shared bounded partial-material scope is an option, but neither four distinct complete formulations nor equality follows without percentage basis/carrier/denaturant/product evidence. Do not infer95%v/v aqueous NCIT identity. Missing composition is not permission to discard the supported partial material.

Existing trackers are reused, not duplicated:1206 JCM852;1210 sodium-thiosulfate tetrahydrate;1202 Polypeptone;1212 Phytone/SoyPeptone;1217 W06 source/solvent provenance;1221 EBIOS;1204 rumen.
